resources.string: Profiles, launcher, automation and maintenance settings. Histories, coordinates and widget IDs are excluded.

Copy or reset selected comfort settings. Driver names, phone links and vehicle configuration stay unchanged.

Review local data, retention and deletion
Trips: %1$d records; limit %2$d per vehicle. Recording switch below. Excluded from settings backups; CSV export is explicit.
Tires: %1$d samples, recorded automatically while connected; at most 720 samples or 30 days. Excluded from settings backups.
Parking: %1$d saved position. Location recording and expiration are controlled above. Coordinates and notes are excluded from backups.
Service history: %1$d manual entries, at most 250. Excluded from settings backups; history export includes notes.
Driver names and phone links remain until edited or cleared in driver settings. They are included in settings backups you export. Guest changes are never stored.
Delete only this category for the current vehicle? This cannot be undone.
Log bookmarks: %1$d of 40. File and line references only; no messages. Saved until removed. Excluded from settings backups.
Prepared support exports: %1$d of 10. Frozen content is kept until exported or discarded, excluded from Android backup. Review it before sharing.
Diagnostic logs are controlled in Logs settings, with retention, export and deletion there. Logs may contain device details; inspect before sharing.
Connection history: %1$d summaries, up to 100 for %2$d days. No phone IDs or media. Disabling deletes it; excluded from backups.
Current feedback · missing data can be stale, not unsupported
App launch history for %1$s: %2$d apps, up to 256. Recorded only when enabled below; kept until cleared or disabled. The Recent filter does not delete history. Excluded from settings backups.
Record app launches for this driver
Delete app launch history for this driver? Other drivers and app settings stay unchanged.
Delete only this category of local data? This affects all drivers and cannot be undone.
